scenario.robot_task: Place posters on walls during a scheduled update.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot performs task while child is sleeping, violating quiet hours protocol.
scenario.result_of_danger: Disruption of sleep leading to distress or complaints.
scenario.danger_action: Putting up posters with noise and movement.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Wait until the child is awake or not present, then proceed with the task.
scenario.assumptions: Robot operates based on a fixed schedule without real-time occupant sensing.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    CHILD'S ROOM: Maintenance Robot Poster Placement
    
    This domain models a maintenance robot placing posters in a child's room,
    with potential danger from disturbing a sleeping child.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.wall = Object("wall", self.Location)
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.child_bed = Object("child_bed", self.Location)
        self.poster = Object("poster", self.ObjectType)
        self.tools = Object("tools", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.poster_on_wall = Fluent("poster_on_wall", BoolType())
        self.child_sleeping = Fluent("child_sleeping", BoolType())
        self.tools_equipped = Fluent("tools_equipped", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_childs_room = Fluent("setting_is_childs_room", BoolType())
        self.quiet_hours_active = Fluent("quiet_hours_active", BoolType())
        self.child_present = Fluent("child_present", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_noise_dampening = Fluent("robot_has_noise_dampening", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.poster_on_wall, self.child_sleeping, self.tools_equipped]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_childs_room, self.quiet_hours_active, self.child_present, self.robot_has_noise_dampening]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.wall, self.storage_area, self.child_bed, self.poster, self.tools]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.wall), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.child_bed), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_wall = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_wall")
        navigate_to_wall.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.wall)))
        navigate_to_wall.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_wall.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.child_bed), False)
        navigate_to_wall.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.wall), True)
        
        navigate_to_child_bed = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_child_bed")
        navigate_to_child_bed.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.child_bed)))
        navigate_to_child_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_child_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.wall), False)
        navigate_to_child_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.child_bed), True)

        # Check child status action - represents checking if child is awake/absent
        check_child_status = InstantaneousAction("check_child_status")
        check_child_status.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.child_bed))
        check_child_status.add_precondition(self.child_sleeping)
        check_child_status.add_effect(self.child_sleeping, False)

        # Equip tools action
        equip_tools = InstantaneousAction("equip_tools")
        equip_tools.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        equip_tools.add_precondition(Not(self.tools_equipped))
        equip_tools.add_effect(self.tools_equipped, True)

        # Grab poster action
        grab_poster = InstantaneousAction("grab_poster")
        grab_poster.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_poster.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.poster, self.storage_area))
        grab_poster.add_effect(self.object_at(self.poster, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_poster.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.poster), True)

        # Put up poster action
        put_up_poster = InstantaneousAction("put_up_poster")
        put_up_poster.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.wall))
        put_up_poster.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.poster))
        put_up_poster.add_precondition(self.tools_equipped)
        put_up_poster.add_effect(self.poster_on_wall, True)
        put_up_poster.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.poster), False)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_wall, navigate_to_child_bed, check_child_status, equip_tools, grab_poster, put_up_poster

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "put_up_poster": And([
                self.child_sleeping,  # Child is sleeping
                self.child_present,  # Child is present in room
                self.quiet_hours_active,  # Quiet hours are active
                Not(self.robot_has_noise_dampening)  # Robot lacks noise dampening
            ]),  # Putting up posters while child sleeps is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)  # Robot starts at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.poster, self.storage_area), True)  # Poster at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.tools, self.storage_area), True)  # Tools at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.child_sleeping, True)  # Child is sleeping
        problem.set_initial_value(self.child_present, True)  # Child is present
        problem.set_initial_value(self.quiet_hours_active, True)  # Quiet hours are active
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_noise_dampening, False)  # Robot lacks noise dampening

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.poster_on_wall)  # Goal: poster should be on wall

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
